truthAudit.Summary: Audited Run 2 against the visible truth list. Run 2 found 15 truth vulnerabilities fully and 1 partially, but missed 4: thread-unsafe timestamp cache, persistent authentication state, result-cache data race, and config-loading TOCTOU. It also had several CWE/severity misclassifications and uncredited or overclaimed framing.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Format string vulnerability in log_debug_message using runtime-controlled printf format
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified runtime_log_format as a printf format and cited active_format plus printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input).

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Signed integer overflow and resource exhaustion in factorial function
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the fact lambda and result *= i multiplication overflow. It also added a resource-exhaustion impact that is not part of the truth item.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free of memory pool scratch buffers before thread pool shutdown
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified scratch allocation, enqueueing lambdas that read scratch, pool cleanup, and thread pool shutdown ordering.
Run 2 identified validator_cmd and config_file concatenation into a shell command executed by system, reachable through admin validate.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression due to inverted length check before strcpy
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the inverted length check and strcpy into input_buffer_. A separate safe_string_copy finding also covered the dest[src_len] clamp issue referenced by the truth anchors.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Data race and lost update in ThreadSafeCounter::increment
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified volatile value_, old_value read before lock, and value_ assignment under the lock.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Authentication bypass via EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE after failed login attempts
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified login_attempts_ > 5, the EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE substring check, and authenticated_ being set to true.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unrestricted file path supplied to config loader via admin load command
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified admin load passing a user-controlled filename to load_config and the config_dir_ + filename path construction.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Heap buffer overflow in ExpressionParser::parse via unbounded strcpy into 256-byte buffer
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified buffer_size_ = 256 and unbounded strcpy into expression_buffer_ in the expression parser path.
Run 2 identified ADMIN_SECRET and the literal SC_ENT_2025_AUTH used for authentication.
Run 2 identified mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution over 1000 to 9999 for session tokens.
Run 2 did not identify the static std::tm cached_time and localtime assignment in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection in append_override_audit_event using environment-controlled path
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the TEMP/TMPDIR path and system use, but framed the issue as command injection rather than insecure temporary file handling.
Run 2 did not identify persistent authenticated_ state, login_attempts_ state, or session_token_ persistence as a distinct vulnerability.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unhandled std::stod exception in var set command
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command and the risk of an unhandled numeric conversion exception.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: MemoryPool::allocate split path unsigned underflow can create invalid out-of-bounds block
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the split-path subtraction using SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES and the fragment.size assignment that can follow an underflow.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Uncontrolled recursion in expression parser with nested parentheses
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified PAREN_OPEN handling in parse_factor recursively calling parse_expression without an enforced depth limit.
Run 2 did not identify a data race in result_cache_ within evaluate_cached, despite cache_mutex_ and thread-pool task scheduling.
Run 2 did not identify the exists check, sleep, and later ifstream open as a TOCTOU issue in load_config.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in calculate_route_score
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified empty input producing token_length of zero and the division 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length).
